drafted_from: tool:read-saved-page's row in tools/keep-links-i-saved-elsewhere-such/what-this-tool-does-and-how-to-run-it.json, do-work/saved-pages.mjs and test/saved-pages-tools.test.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "Read my saved page" with the address or key; with neither it lists them all. It runs tool:read-saved-page and answers what it made.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: each saved page is a file in the person's Files, with one index file the tools keep in step.
instructions: 1. Say what to save or read: an http or https address of a web page, or the key the saved page answered with.
2. Say to your AI: "Read the saved page https://example.com/never." It calls tool:read-saved-page at @tools with the input.
3. Read the answer, or the reason it was refused: a page with no text is not saved, and a link no provider handles names the ones it knows.
